req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a PUT request to update a non-existent task should return a 404 error. This behavior needs to be verified through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the system correctly identifies non-existent tasks and responds with the appropriate HTTP status code.

tests.name: Update existing task
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to update task with id 1
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Update an existing task
response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={"title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated description", "completed": true}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Task"
assert response.json()["description"] == "Updated description"
assert response.json()["completed"] is True

tests.name: Update non-existent task
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send PUT request to update task with id 999
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update a non-existent task
response = client.put(
    "/tasks/999",
    json={"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: Update task with boundary id
preconditions: Task with id 20 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to update task with id 20
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Update a task with boundary id
response = client.put(
    "/tasks/20",
    json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary case description", "completed": true}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == "Boundary Task"
assert response.json()["description"] == "Boundary case description"
assert response.json()["completed"] is True
